'''Rookie''', designated '''CT-3899''',was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

==Biography==
On his first assignment, Rookie was placed under command of sergeant [[Kano]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in the aftermath of the liberation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] capital, [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]]. Commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], Kano, Rookie and other rookie troopers were tasked with cleaning the remaining pockets of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] resistance from the city of [[Resdin]]. Rookie was extremely eager to put his training to the test and show his brother what he was made of. After the last pocket of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was wiped out, Kano congratulated the shinies on completing their first assignment and commented on them not being [[Shiny/Legends|shinies]] anymore.<ref name="Republic Heroes" />
